title: Alaska Elects Its First Democratic Governor Since 1998
excerpt: Alaska voters have elected Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins as governor — the first Democrat to win the office since 1998 — with over 50 percent of first-choice votes.
content:
Alaska voters have elected a Democrat as governor for the first time since 1998. The Associated Press called the race Friday for former state lawmaker Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, part of a midterm wave that has now given Democrats the governor's office in 30 states.

Kreiss-Tomkins won outright, with 50.8 percent of first-choice votes — 139,293 votes of 256,823 counted by Thursday — avoiding a ranked-choice runoff under Alaska's system. His closest rival, Trump-endorsed Republican Bernadette Wilson, had 28.1 percent. Former Anchorage Mayor Dave Bronson took 13.6 percent, and former Attorney General Treg Taylor 7.2 percent, according to the Alaska Division of Elections' unofficial summary.

The AP called the race 10 days after the polls closed; CNN had called it Thursday night. The result is not yet official: the Division of Elections will finish counting absentee and questioned ballots by November 18 and aims to certify the result on November 25. Kreiss-Tomkins will be sworn in at noon on December 7. His lieutenant governor is Zac Johnson, an independent.

Why it matters beyond Alaska

Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state representative from Sitka, campaigned on a willingness to work across party lines, and he defeated three Republicans in a state that has not elected a Democratic governor in 28 years. At 37, he will be Alaska's youngest governor.

The win caps a midterm cycle in which Democrats flipped governors' offices in states including Iowa, Georgia, Ohio and Texas, according to the Associated Press — a sweep that reshaped state government across the country. The Texas flip is the one closest to home for Webb County readers: the same November 3 midterm wave that decided races here also changed who holds the governor's office in Austin.

Alaska's U.S. Senate race, meanwhile, is still uncalled.
